question: Which other classes of beings are included in this encompassing vision, O beloved?
premises: Kinnaras, Yakṣas, and Nāgas are included
inference: The encompassing vision also includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
